intro: Warsong Supplies is an expansive Horde logistics quest issued by Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post. Keeping the Warsong Lumber Camp operational demands reclaiming vital logging gear scattered across hostile furbolg and satyr territories, alongside imports arriving from distant goblin ports.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend. You've saved me a lot of work!
But don't think that I'm not grateful!
